title: Maximum time calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 25 s.

title: Brushed distance calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 10 m.

title: Acceleration from friction
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law to find the deceleration as a = μ₁g for the unbrushed section.

title: Kinematics for stopping time
description: Important: Uses the correct constant-acceleration kinematics (v = v₀ + at) to solve for the time to stop.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly, accounting for work done by friction over both brushed and unbrushed segments.

title: Distance variable definition
description: Important: Clearly defines the brushed distance (d) and the total distance (s = 30 m) in the work-energy equation.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns positive work to the friction force instead of negative work, leading to a wrong distance.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the calculation and presents final answers with correct units.
